title: DAG sprint rapporteert 'completed' terwijl ticket op 'interrupted' eindigt
source_context: orchestrate.py sprint --auto, DAG phase 1/1 met 3 parallelle tickets, 2026-07-03
description: In een DAG-fase van sprint 2 (Eren Rent) rapporteerde de sprint-output '[EREN-033] @fullstack-morty: completed' en 'DAG sprint results: 3/3 completed', maar het ticket stond daarna op status 'interrupted' met lege agent_output, met half werk in de working tree. De sprint-loop plande het ticket vervolgens niet opnieuw in — het bleef hangen tot handmatige interventie (status terug naar todo).
proposed_changes: Completion-status in de DAG-runner komt niet uit de ticket-JSON zelf; lees na afloop van elke parallelle delegatie de echte ticketstatus terug en requeue tickets met status interrupted/onbekend automatisch.

triage.evidence: orchestrate.py:510 `return {"ticket_id": ticket_id, "agent": agent, "status": "completed", "output": output[-500:]}` — status derived only from absence of exception; run_delegate (line 240) `subprocess.run(..., capture_output=True)` with no returncode check; delegate.py:2978 `ticket["status"] = "interrupted"` then plain `return` (exit 0); orchestrate.py:1416 handles only `if t["status"] == "in_review"`; orchestrate.py:1169 `if t["status"] not in ("todo", "backlog"): continue` — interrupted never requeued. Last commits to orchestrate.py (c09b11b, e3d3a76) left all these lines intact; b680ed9 touched sleepy fixes, not this path.
triage.note: Bug still present and mechanism confirmed end-to-end: run_delegate (orchestrate.py:240) ignores the subprocess return code; _dag_delegate (line 510) labels any non-raising delegation 'completed' without reading the ticket JSON, while delegate.py:2978 sets status 'interrupted' on timeout and returns cleanly; the DAG result loop (1413-1441) only handles 'in_review', get_actionable_tickets (1169) only requeues todo/backlog, and the sprint exit check (1383) ignores 'interrupted' — so the ticket strands exactly as described. Fix is confined to orchestrate.py (not prometheus.py): read back real ticket status in _dag_delegate and requeue interrupted tickets (with a retry cap to avoid loops). Multi-spot, single-file change → M.
